name: KEEQuant
description: KEEQuant is a German quantum security company developing quantum key distribution (QKD) systems using integrated photonics. The company provides secure quantum communication solutions for critical infrastructure, government, and enterprise applications, protecting against current and future cyber threats.

products.name: QKD System
products.description: Integrated photonic quantum key distribution system for secure communication over fiber networks

highlights: Pioneering integrated-photonics approach to quantum key distribution in Germany
Focused on critical infrastructure and government-grade quantum security

news.title: Quantum-Sovereign AI for Organizations
news.excerpt: Quantum-Sovereign AI – from critical risk to trusted solution KEEQuant, Collaider and noris network demonstrate a sovereign AI model that combines quantum-secured communication, trusted German infrastructure
